mapper.select: SELECT WORKFLOW_ID, WORKFLOW_NAME, WORKFLOW_DESC, ENABLE_FLAG, PVALUE, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM WF_DEFINITIONS WHERE WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId}
SELECT WORKFLOW_ID, WORKFLOW_NAME, WORKFLOW_DESC, ENABLE_FLAG, PVALUE, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM WF_DEFINITIONS WHERE WORKFLOW_NAME = #{workflowName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WF_DEFINITIONS ( WORKFLOW_ID, WORKFLOW_NAME, WORKFLOW_DESC, ENABLE_FLAG, PVALUE, CREATED_BY, CREATION_DATE, LAST_UPDATED_BY, LAST_UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{workflowId}, #{workflowName}, #{workflowDesc}, #{enableFlag}, #{pvalue}, #{createdBy}, #{creationDate}, #{lastUpdatedBy}, #{lastUpdateDate} )
mapper.update: UPDATE WF_DEFINITIONS SET WORKFLOW_NAME = #{workflowName}, WORKFLOW_DESC = #{workflowDesc}, ENABLE_FLAG = #{enableFlag}, PVALUE = #{pvalue}, LAST_UPDATED_BY = #{lastUpdatedBy}, LAST_UPDATE_DATE = #{lastUpdateDate} WHERE WORKFLOW_ID = #{workflowId}
